name: mindtrail-retrieval-holdout
description: Second held-out set, sealed before the reranker work began and evaluated only once, at the end. Domains: game studio, Go payments service, documentation site, research lab. Weighted toward paraphrase, the hardest category.

memories.content: The game is built in Unity 2022 LTS using the Universal Render Pipeline
Gameplay scripts are C# and must not allocate memory inside Update loops
Large binary assets are tracked with Git LFS
Nightly builds for Steam are produced by a TeamCity pipeline
Player progress is saved to the cloud through PlayFab
Target frame rate is 60 fps on the Steam Deck
Localization strings are managed in a shared Google Sheet exported to CSV
The multiplayer backend uses Photon Fusion with a host-client model
Multiplayer moved from Photon Fusion to Unity Netcode for GameObjects
The payments service is written in Go 1.22 and exposes gRPC APIs
Money amounts are stored as integer minor units, never floats
Every payment request must carry an idempotency key
The ledger is double-entry and lives in CockroachDB
Card data never touches our servers; tokenization is done by Adyen
Database access code is generated with sqlc from SQL queries in db/queries
Service-to-service calls are authenticated with mTLS certificates issued by SPIFFE
The PCI audit is scheduled for March
The PCI audit was postponed to May
Refund processing is disabled while the ledger migration runs
The documentation site is built with Docusaurus and deployed to Netlify
Every docs page needs a front-matter description of under 160 characters for SEO
Code samples in the docs are tested by extracting them in CI
Diagrams are written in Mermaid, not exported as images
Versioned docs are kept for the last three major releases
Experiments run on the university Slurm cluster; submit jobs with sbatch
Results must be logged with the git commit hash of the code that produced them
Paper drafts are written in LaTeX on Overleaf
Human-subject data must stay on the encrypted lab server and never go to cloud storage
Figures are generated with matplotlib using the lab style file
User prefers step-by-step instructions for anything involving the terminal
User is learning Go and appreciates brief explanations of Go idioms
User's working hours are 7am to 3pm and they avoid late meetings
